articleTitle: Is Your Workout Routine Bloated or Just Balanced?
imageHeadline: Too many rows, not enough squats?
imageSubtext: How to tell if your workout is unbalanced—or just more varied
pinTitle: Is Your Workout Routine Bloated or Just Balanced? Movement Pattern Audit
pinDescription: If you're doing three row variations and two chest presses but your glutes aren't growing, your routine might not be bloated—it might be unbalanced. Learn how to audit your program using movement patterns, set volume per muscle group, and goal alignment to build a routine that's both effective and enjoyable.

items.label: List every exercise by movement pattern
Count total sets per week for each category
Compare your volume to your actual goals
Adjust exercises to match what you need
